Subject: TrustRadius / short case call — quick ask

Hi Samir,

Hope you’re doing well — we really appreciate the work ByteBridge has done with Redwood over the last quarter. We’ve been compiling short customer notes for TrustRadius and a handful of other review sites to help prospective customers understand how teams like yours use our Dedicated offering.

Would you be open to two things?
1) A very short TrustRadius review (4–6 sentences) — we can draft a starter and you can edit.
2) A 20–30 minute call next week to capture one quote and one short usage snippet for a case blurb we can publish.

We’re offering a $75 Amazon e-gift card as a thank-you for participation, and we’ll share a templated draft so it’s low lift on your side. If helpful, I can loop in Ben from Customer Advocacy to handle fulfillment and Marissa on the case logistics.

No pressure — if it’s not a fit right now, a short note back is fine. If you are interested, what’s the best day/time?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber

2) Are there any legal/PR approvals required before you publish the quote?
3) Timeline — we’re in a busy window next week; the earliest we could do is Tue or Thu afternoons (PDT).

3) Thanks for availability. Tue 2–4pm PDT or Thu 3–5pm PDT both work from our side. If you pick a slot, Marissa will send a calendar invite and a short agenda (20–25min).
